note: Seasonal faith series for Premium. Advent ends on Christmas Day (its list is read from the end). Lent counts weekdays from Ash Wednesday, with its own Sunday list ending on Easter. Ramadan start dates are estimates and can shift a day with the moon sighting.

days.text: Advent begins in the dark, waiting for light. Whatever you're waiting on, you aren't waiting alone.
days.quote: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light.

days.text: Let today be gentle. Comfort is part of God's plan, not a detour from it.
days.quote: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.

days.text: Clear a little room today: a quiet minute, an open hour, a softer heart.
days.quote: Prepare the way for the Lord.

days.text: If you feel tired, that's not the end of the story. Strength can be renewed.
days.quote: Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength.

days.text: Waiting can be an act of trust. Hold on to hope a little longer.
days.quote: I wait for the Lord, my whole being waits, and in his word I put my hope.

days.text: Courage isn't the absence of worry. It's taking heart anyway.
days.quote: Wait for the Lord; be strong and take heart.

days.text: In a busy season, stillness is a gift you can give yourself today.
days.quote: Be still, and know that I am God.

days.text: Even a small light is enough to change a dark room.
days.quote: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

days.text: The promise came as a child: small, quiet and full of hope.
days.quote: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given.

days.text: Bring your questions to the One who counsels with love.
days.quote: And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

days.text: The peace offered to you isn't fragile. It's yours to rest in today.
days.quote: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you.

days.text: Mercy is tender, and it rises like the morning.
days.quote: Because of the tender mercy of our God, the rising sun will come to us from heaven.

days.text: Take one step on the path of peace today. One is enough.
days.quote: To guide our feet into the path of peace.

days.text: Joy doesn't wait for everything to be fixed. Let it in today.
days.quote: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

days.text: Name one worry, hand it over in prayer, and breathe.
days.quote: The Lord is near. Do not be anxious about anything.

days.text: You are seen with favour, even when you feel ordinary.
days.quote: Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God.

days.text: What feels impossible today is not the final word.
days.quote: For no word from God will ever fail.

days.text: A simple yes can open the door to something beautiful.
days.quote: I am the Lord's servant. May your word to me be fulfilled.

days.text: Let your heart sing today, even quietly.
days.quote: My soul glorifies the Lord and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior.

days.text: Every bit of love you give today started with love given to you.
days.quote: We love because he first loved us.

days.text: The heart of this season is a gift, given freely and for everyone.
days.quote: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son.

days.text: God came close, into ordinary life. Look for Him in yours today.
days.quote: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us.

days.text: God with us: in the kitchen, the commute, the hard conversation.
days.quote: They will call him Immanuel, which means 'God with us.'

days.text: Small places matter to God. So do small people and small acts.
days.quote: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel.

days.text: Lift your eyes. Your light is closer than you think.
days.quote: Arise, shine, for your light has come.

days.text: Peace on earth starts with peace in one heart. Let it start in yours.
days.quote: Glory to God in the highest heaven, and on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests.

days.text: Christmas Eve. Good news is on its way, and it's meant for you too.
days.quote: I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people.

days.text: Merry Christmas. The waiting is over, and love has come near.
days.quote: Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.

days.text: Ash Wednesday. You are small and you are loved. Both are true today.
days.quote: For dust you are and to dust you will return.

days.text: Lent is a chance to begin again, from the inside out.
days.quote: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

days.text: It's never too late to turn around. The door is open.
days.quote: Return to me with all your heart.

days.text: God cares more about your heart than your appearances.
days.quote: Rend your heart and not your garments.

days.text: Whatever you're giving up, let it make room for what feeds your soul.
days.quote: Man shall not live on bread alone.

days.text: Find a quiet corner today. Prayer doesn't need an audience.
days.quote: When you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father.

days.text: Notice where your attention goes today. That's where your heart is.
days.quote: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

days.text: If you're weary, you're invited, not judged.
days.quote: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

days.text: Your weak places are where grace does its best work.
days.quote: My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.

days.text: If your heart feels broken today, God isn't far from it.
days.quote: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted.

days.text: Be honest with God today. He already knows, and He stays.
days.quote: Search me, God, and know my heart.

days.text: Forgiveness flows both ways. Is there someone you could release today?
days.quote: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

days.text: Love your neighbour, and remember you're allowed to love yourself too.
days.quote: Love your neighbor as yourself.

days.text: Mercy given is never wasted.
days.quote: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.

days.text: A clear heart sees more clearly.
days.quote: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

days.text: Be the calm in one conversation today.
days.quote: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

days.text: You are cared for, step by step.
days.quote: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

days.text: Let today restore you a little.
days.quote: He restores my soul.

days.text: Hard valleys are real. So is the One who walks them with you.
days.quote: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.

days.text: You don't need to see the whole road. Just the next step.
days.quote: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

days.text: Stay connected today. Fruit grows from staying close.
days.quote: I am the vine; you are the branches.

days.text: Follow the light you have, and more will come.
days.quote: I am the light of the world.

days.text: Even what feels finished can be made new.
days.quote: I am the resurrection and the life.

days.text: Tears are not a lack of faith. Jesus cried too.
days.quote: Jesus wept.

days.text: Let someone off the hook today, including yourself.
days.quote: Do not judge, and you will not be judged.

days.text: Generosity tends to come back around.
days.quote: Give, and it will be given to you.

days.text: No one is too far gone to be welcomed home.
days.quote: This brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.

days.text: You are worth searching for.
days.quote: Rejoice with me; I have found my lost sheep.

days.text: Faith is a daily choice, made in small ways.
days.quote: Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.

days.text: Choose patience once today. That's love in action.
days.quote: Love is patient, love is kind.

days.text: A kind word can soften a hard day, for them and for you.
days.quote: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other.

days.text: Change starts in how you think. Give your mind something good today.
days.quote: Be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

days.text: Nothing you face today can cut you off from love.
days.quote: Neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God.

days.text: You won't have to find all the strength on your own.
days.quote: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.

days.text: Holy Week begins. Make a little space for prayer today.
days.quote: My house will be called a house of prayer.

days.text: Greatness looks like service. Who can you help today?
days.quote: Whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant.

days.text: Your love doesn't need to be grand to be beautiful.
days.quote: She has done a beautiful thing to me.

days.text: Maundy Thursday. Love one another, starting close to home.
days.quote: A new command I give you: Love one another.

days.text: Good Friday. Even here, the first words are forgiveness.
days.quote: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.

days.text: Holy Saturday. The quiet in-between. Morning is coming.
days.quote: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

sundays.text: Sundays in Lent are for rest and gladness. Breathe today.
sundays.quote: This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

sundays.text: Notice one good thing today and savour it.
sundays.quote: Taste and see that the Lord is good.

sundays.text: Joy can be strength. Let yourself smile today.
sundays.quote: The joy of the Lord is your strength.

sundays.text: Halfway through Lent. Rejoice in how far you've come.
sundays.quote: I rejoiced with those who said to me, 'Let us go to the house of the Lord.'

sundays.text: Something new is growing, even if you can't see it yet.
sundays.quote: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it?

sundays.text: Palm Sunday. Welcome Him in, with whatever you have.
sundays.quote: Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

sundays.text: Happy Easter. Love is stronger than death, and hope is alive.
sundays.quote: He is not here; he has risen!

days.text: Ramadan Mubarak. Fasting is a path to closeness, not a test of perfection.
days.quote: O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous.

days.text: This is the month of the Qur'an. Open it today, even for one verse.
days.quote: The month of Ramadhan in which was revealed the Qur'an, a guidance for the people.

days.text: Be gentle with yourself as you settle in. Allah wants ease for you.
days.quote: Allah intends for you ease and does not intend for you hardship.

days.text: Make a du'a today. You are heard.
days.quote: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

days.text: Remember Him in small moments, and you are remembered.
days.quote: So remember Me; I will remember you.

days.text: Patience is easier when you know you're not alone in it.
days.quote: Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

days.text: If today is hard, ease is already on its way.
days.quote: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

days.text: Let dhikr steady your heart today.
days.quote: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.

days.text: You are not asked to carry more than you can.
days.quote: Allah does not charge a soul except with that within its capacity.

days.text: However far you feel, the door of mercy is open.
days.quote: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

days.text: Wherever your day takes you, you are accompanied.
days.quote: And He is with you wherever you are.

days.text: You are known completely, and still held close.
days.quote: We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

days.text: Ask boldly today. Allah invites you to call on Him.
days.quote: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

days.text: Count one blessing before iftar tonight.
days.quote: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.

days.text: Halfway there. Rely on Allah for the rest.
days.quote: And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for him.

days.text: Mercy is wider than any mistake.
days.quote: My mercy encompasses all things.

days.text: Give from something you love today, however small.
days.quote: Never will you attain the good until you spend from that which you love.

days.text: Let your words be gentle, especially when you're hungry.
days.quote: And speak to people good words.

days.text: Answer harshness with something better. It can change hearts.
days.quote: Repel evil by that which is better.

days.text: Do one good thing beautifully today.
days.quote: Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.

days.text: The last ten nights begin. Seek Laylat al-Qadr with hope.
days.quote: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

days.text: Let tonight be peaceful, whatever the day held.
days.quote: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

days.text: A du'a for these nights: ask for pardon, and trust that He loves to pardon.
days.quote: O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me.

days.text: Check your intention today. It gives every act its weight.
days.quote: Actions are only by intentions.

days.text: Small and steady is beloved. Keep going.
days.quote: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done regularly, even if they are few.

days.text: Your fasting, done with faith, is not wasted.
days.quote: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and in hope of reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.

days.text: Share your iftar with someone if you can.
days.quote: Whoever gives food to a fasting person to break his fast will have a reward like his.

days.text: A smile is charity. Give one away today.
days.quote: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity.

days.text: Ask for good in this life and the next.
days.quote: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good.

days.text: As Ramadan closes, give thanks for every day you were given.
days.quote: And to complete the period and to glorify Allah for that to which He has guided you; and perhaps you will be grateful.
